leucistic.belBody: A Blue Eyed Leucistic is produced when two compatible genes from the BEL complex are combined. Common BEL complex genes include Mojave, Lesser, Butter, Russo, Mystic, Phantom, and Special.
leucistic.belExamples: Example combinations: Mojave + Lesser, Mojave + Butter, Lesser + Russo, Mystic + Mojave, Phantom + Mojave.
leucistic.belSameGene: Select two different genes for Blue Eyed Leucistic.
leucistic.blackEyeBody: Black-eyed leucistics are created as super forms of certain genes. Select one gene and the app records it as the correct super form automatically.
leucistic.blackEyeExamples: Examples: Fire + Fire creates Super Fire, Lesser + Lesser creates Super Lesser, Butter + Butter creates Super Butter.
leucistic.intro: When entering BEL in genetics, the app requires the exact genes that create the leucistic animal. BEL is not a standalone gene; it is a visual outcome produced by specific gene combinations.
leucistic.title: Select Leucistic Type
leucistic.why: Defining the exact genes keeps genetics records accurate, preserves breeding outcomes, and ensures pairing predictions are correct.
